validation.checks: See the commit CI run for the complete public snapshot checks.

boundaries: Only the audio correctness burn and YouTube input-quality coverage/freshness residuals can be reclassified by the bounded assessment.
Formal SLI/history, thresholds, existing notification delivery routes and recovery authority are preserved.
No credentials, raw evidence, working deployment configuration or production release identity are included.
The existing public quick-evaluator entrypoint owns the assessment; no private-only alternate entrypoint is needed.
The quick assessment also applies to older hourly duplicate notices during notification bootstrap, independently of external-checker availability.
